title: toona sureni var. pubescens
intro: Toona sureni var. pubescens, commonly known as the Chinese cedar, is a plant species within the Meliaceae family. It is a deciduous tree native to southern China and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Toona sureni var. pubescens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including terpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-cancer, and immunomodulatory effects.
